notes.author: pete
notes.text: Patrick and Erin shared that they are planning a move to Ohio to be closer to family. No date yet. They want to keep leading their group until they go.
notes.testPurpose: Notes on an inactive family from before they moved.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Liam's room leaders made him a card signed by the whole group to take with him when the family moves.

notes.author: alisha
notes.text: Erin called to thank the staff before the move. She asked that we keep the family's record and send mail to their new address once they have one.
